feeds.title: Wealthy Single Mommy
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Emma Johnson and my goal is to help you build a full, awesome life as a single mom. I started Wealthysinglemommy when I realized a huge need for community, information and inspiration for women like me. Follow my blog for more.

feeds.title: MomTrends
feeds.description: Nicole Feliciano launched MomTrends in 2007 to provide moms the latest news on things trendy and cool for families. MomTrends filled her need to create and share the best of motherhood. Nicole has built an amazing team of women to grow the business, but she remains the passionate leader.

feeds.title: Stroller in the City
feeds.description: Brianne Manz writes about fashion, travel and all things kids while living a fast-paced NYC life as a wife and mom to three. This Blog is about fashion, trends and styles for Children and Moms in New York City.

feeds.title: Lady and the Blog
feeds.description: Lady and the Blog is a blog founded by Vera Sweeney in 2005. The blog covers a variety of topics including parenting, travel, fashion, and more. Vera's mission is to provide a resource for busy mothers to find tips and inspiration to live their best lives. Lady and the Blog helps busy women stay on top of the latest trends in fashion, food, family, and travel.

feeds.title: In Jennie's Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jennie. Thanks for joining me in this journey called life, and welcome to my journal filled with stories about food, family, life & the crossroads where they meet.

feeds.title: Kori at Home
feeds.description: I am Kori and I am so excited to have you here today at Kori at Home. If you are looking for those easy recipes, fun kids activities, and homemaking tips to simplify motherhood and bring back the joy? I am here to help. And along the way, let us look for the ways to reclaim the joy of motherhood and find your why of motherhood.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Farm Girl
feeds.description: Brooklyn Farm Girl shows you that it's possible to grow your own food anywhere, even without a backyard. Pamela, the girl behind the blog, is a film director by day and wrangles kids and cooks recipes by night. Discover hundreds of easy recipe ideas cooked from scratch with homegrown vegetables. From urban gardening to Motherhood, she writes about it all.

feeds.title: Mom In The City
feeds.description: Covers easy recipes, fun family activities, parenting tips, working from home advice and some 'just for mom' finds. Mom In The City is a work from home mom lifestyle blog.

feeds.title: Westchester NY Moms Blog
feeds.description: Westchester NY Moms is a kid friendly guide to Westchester County, NY for Moms from Moms. Find things to do, places to go, local businesses and more for your family.

feeds.title: Penelope Guzman
feeds.description: Long Island New York mom blogger and photographer Penelope Guzman, a freelance writer, content creator, and photographer living on Long Island, NY writes about happy home life and marriage, delicious healthy keto and low-carb recipes, home decorating, beauty tips and hair tutorials, and family travel.

feeds.title: The Mint Chip Mama
feeds.description: Welcome to The Mint Chip Mama! A parenting blog where we share great ideas & places to visit on Long Island & the Tri-State area for moms, dads, & families. We also love to share all kinds of fun things we do at home, new products that rock our world. Get updates about local hikes, art, games, products we love, mom brain & fun stuff at home!

feeds.title: Mommy Shorts
feeds.description: My name is Ilana. I'm a working mom from NYC who writes a blog instead of sleeping. I have two daughters. Harlow is seven-years-old and Mazzy is ten. My husband's name is Mike. I love him slightly more than my computer. But slightly less than ice cream. The four of us plan to stay in downtown Manhattan until someone drags us kicking and screaming to the burbs. Follow my journey through my blog.

feeds.title: Amy Ever After
feeds.description: Covers well-researched reviews, recipes, gift guides, and more from a mom of teens who is passionate about baking, shopping, and so much more!

feeds.title: A Child Grows
feeds.description: A Child Grows is the largest parenting website in Brooklyn, NY, and one of the best-known parenting blogs in the NYC area. It's considered the go-to resource for Brooklyn families and we are always striving to have the most up-to-date and relevant information for parents in Brooklyn. Learn about parenting resources, schools, camps, classes, neighborhood news, family-friendly events, gear, trends, and everything in between.

feeds.title: NYC Tech Mommy
feeds.description: Inspiring families to live simple, live fun, and live life by sharing family lifestyle, tech and travel. Author Monica Encarnacion is born and raised in New Yorker, former educator, Latina, and mommy of two.

feeds.title: The Mogul Mom Blog
feeds.description: Providing educational, actionable, inspiring tips, ideas, and information to thousands of women from around the globe, through in-depth articles, interviews with successful entrepreneurs, and more.

feeds.title: Football Food & Motherhood
feeds.description: I am Stephanie Barnhart. I am a Writer, Editor and small business owner by day, mom by life. I take life seriously, as in - you better seriously enjoy every day to the fullest. Follow for parenting tips and survival guide for moms and dads, even outside of NYC.
